title: How a request travels
lede: Client, route matcher, route handler, introspection and backend. A simulated evaluator, not real PingGateway: drag any box, then press Simulate.

nodes.label: Client
sub: Sends the request, with or without a Bearer token.

nodes.label: Route matcher
sub: Tests every route's condition. First by name wins.

nodes.label: Route handler
sub: The resource-server filter reads the token, audience, scope.

nodes.label: Backend
sub: Reached only when the token is accepted.

steps.title: Route chosen
steps.what: The matcher tests each route's condition and picks the first that is true.

steps.title: Introspect
steps.what: The handler finds a Bearer token and asks the mock authorization server about it.

steps.title: Forward
steps.what: The token is active, for this audience, with the right scope.
